items.title: Dave Pell interviewed by Monk Rowe, Sarasota, Florida, April 11, 1996
items.q: Lester became Prez because she said he was the President of all saxophone players.

ctx.x: Well one other thing that Lester did that’s kind of, I’m thinking about it, Lester would do, if you were going to play a thing where you play one chorus and you know, Chu Berry was on Basie’s band, and Chu Berry is playing a chorus on “Lady Be Good.” And it’s a delight. It is a delight. And Lester is sitting there getting pissed. And he’s burning. And he’s getting mad. And he starts thinking man, I’ll show these assholes. Lester used to come up with these things which I’m going to play in the band today, things…
Were you under his influence coming up?
